title: 弹窗里的人员选择器：内嵌下拉列表滚不动（与 #36825 查找选择器同一类滚动锁缺口）
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① an interaction defect, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7122476885). Source: L1 record 7122452658, item N2, on PR #36844 (Fixes #36825). It is outside that card.

## What happens

When a PeoplePicker (user field) opens its inline popover inside a dialog, its list cannot be scrolled with the wheel or by touch.

The popover is portalled outside the dialog, so it sits outside the dialog's scroll lock, and the lock swallows the wheel and touch events over it. PR #36844 fixes the same gap for LookupField by opening that popover as `modal` and pinning its footer outside the list.

On main 5c2e34cd, `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/PeoplePicker.tsx` (~line 726) renders the inline combobox as `<Popover open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>` with no `modal`.

reach: read from code and from the L1 record, not measured in a browser. It reaches anyone picking a user in a dialog form (quick create, edit dialogs) whose candidate list is longer than the popover.

## Expected

The people list scrolls by wheel and by touch when the picker is opened inside a dialog, as the lookup picker does after #36844.

## Acceptance

- Inside a dialog, the PeoplePicker's inline list scrolls by wheel and by touch on desktop, and the mobile sheet path is unchanged.
- The fix follows #36844's treatment (a modal popover) unless the dev finds PeoplePicker needs another one, named in the PR.
- A test pins the popover's modal setting in the dialog case, as #36844 does for LookupField.

Dedupe: open issues for PeoplePicker plus scroll, PeoplePicker plus dialog and people picker popover scroll return only the lookup cards #36825 and #36832, which stay separate.
